candidates.title: Stripe Accounting Software: Solving the Payout Black Box with LedgerLink
candidates.excerpt: When Stripe deposits funds into your bank account, it lands as a single net lump sum—such as $14,250.40—masking gross billings, interchange fees, customer refunds, and dispute reserves. Booking these net deposits directly as sales understates top-line revenue, conceals operating expenses, and violates statutory accounting standards like ASC 606 and IFRS 15. Meet LedgerLink (https://apps.giniloh.com/ledgerlink)—a specialized, deterministic financial reconciliation utility that automatically decomposes netted Stripe payouts into categorized double-entry General Ledger (GL) journal lines. Strict Mathematical Invariant: The engine (stripeRecon.ts) enforces a zero-tolerance invariant where total debits and credits balance down to the exact cent, flagging any variance immediately. Automated GL Categorization: Cleans and sorts transactions into standard double-entry rows including Revenue, Stripe Fees, Refunds, and Chargebacks. Zero-Trust Privacy: Run calculations locally in your browser via JSON exports, or fetch directly from Stripe using read-only restricted keys (rk_…) while blocking master secret keys (sk_…). Accounting Software & Agent Ready: Generates pre-formatted CSV imports for QuickBooks Online and Xero, and exposes the reconcile_stripe_payout tool via WebMCP for autonomous AI accounting agents.

candidates.title: Agentic AI Adoption Soars, But Profits Stall in 2026
candidates.excerpt: Forty percent of billion-dollar companies now deploy AI agents across their operations—up from just 27 percent a year ago. That's not incremental growth. That's a strategic inflection point, and IT leaders who treat agentic AI adoption as a wait-and-see proposition are already behind. Agentic AI is defined as autonomous software systems that perceive their environment, make decisions, and execute multi-step tasks with minimal human intervention—distinct from generative AI's content creation and traditional automation's rigid rule-following. The enterprises pulling ahead aren't just experimenting. They're delegating routine workflows to agents while repositioning human talent toward judgment, oversight, and strategy. The payoff is measurable: operational efficiency gains, faster cycle times, and workforce augmentation that multiplies output without proportional headcount growth. But scaling requires more than procurement—it demands governance frameworks, security protocols, and a phased roadmap that moves from pilot to production without exposing the enterprise to runaway autonomy or compliance failure. The adoption window is narrowing. Competitors are already building the playbooks, and the gap between early movers and laggards compounds quarterly.

candidates.title: Stripe Accounting Software: Solving the Payout Black Box with LedgerLink
candidates.excerpt: When Stripe deposits funds into your bank account, it lands as a single net lump sum—such as $14,250.40—masking gross billings, interchange fees, customer refunds, and dispute reserves. Booking these net deposits directly as sales understates top-line revenue, conceals operating expenses, and violates statutory accounting standards like ASC 606 and IFRS 15. Meet LedgerLink (https://apps.giniloh.com/ledgerlink)—a specialized, deterministic financial reconciliation utility that automatically decomposes netted Stripe payouts into categorized double-entry General Ledger (GL) journal lines. Strict Mathematical Invariant: The engine (stripeRecon.ts) enforces a zero-tolerance invariant where total debits and credits balance down to the exact cent, flagging any variance immediately. Automated GL Categorization: Cleans and sorts transactions into standard double-entry rows including Revenue, Stripe Fees, Refunds, and Chargebacks. Zero-Trust Privacy: Run calculations locally in your browser via JSON exports, or fetch directly from Stripe using read-only restricted keys (rk_…) while blocking master secret keys (sk_…). Accounting Software & Agent Ready: Generates pre-formatted CSV imports for QuickBooks Online and Xero, and exposes the reconcile_stripe_payout tool via WebMCP for autonomous AI accounting agents.
